1.

The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the respondents to pay suitable compensation to the petitioner for acquisition of his raiyati land appertaining to Mouja Bagda, Thana Kasmar, Thana no.103, Khata no.1, plot no.235, measuring an area of 22.90 decimals;
plot no.1583 measuring an area of 7.80 decimal; and plot no.1584, measuring an area of 16.60 decimals; total 47.30 decimals for widening/strengthening of road between Barlanga and Kasmar via Nemra, as the petitioner and other concerned raiyats have been issued notice by the District Land Acquisition Officer, Bokaro- respondent no.4 under Section 21(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 Charan Mahto vs The State Of Jharkhand on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67776144/

sentences.text: 1 (hereinafter to be referred as 'the Act, 2013'), which has been published in the local daily newspaper 'Dainik Jagran' (Dhanbad Edition) on 10th January, 2023.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the descendant of Khatiyani raiyats and has paid rent for the said land till 2022.

It is further submitted that in the notice issued by the respondent no.4 under Section 21(2) of the Act, 2013, the name of the petitioner has been mentioned along with others, however, he has not been paid any compensation.
The petitioner has represented the respondent no.4 in this regard, however, the same has not been responded, which has compelled him to file the present writ petition.

3. A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent nos.3 to 5, stating, inter alia, that the respondent no.4 has already prepared awards with respect to the land of Khata no.1 i.e. award no.2 with respect to plot no.235, area 0.2290 acre; award no.68 with respect to plot no.1583, area 0.780 acre; and award no.69 with respect to plot no.1584, area 0.1660 acre.
The awardees are descendants of Khatiyani raiyats, namely, Bhikhu Mahto, Mohan Mahto and Mathur Mahto.

The respondents are ready to pay the compensation to the concerned awardees, however, the petitioner is not one of the awardees with respect to acquisition of the said land and, therefore, it is not possible to pay compensation to him.
Moreover, no objection from the petitioner has been received in the office of the respondent no.4 with respect to preparation of the awards.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the materials available on record.

It has been averred in the counter affidavit filed on behalf of the respondent nos.3 to 5 that award nos.2, 68 and 69 have been prepared with respect to the concerned land, however, the petitioner is not one of the awardees.

In support of the said averment, copies of the notices issued under Section 37(2) of the Act, 2013 with respect to Land Acquisition Case no.09 of 2021-22 have been annexed as Annexure-A series to the counter affidavit.
In the said notices, the name of the petitioner has not been mentioned as one of the awardees.

Under the said circumstance no writ of mandamus, as has been prayed by the petitioner in the present writ petition, can be issued to the respondent no.4.
5.
The petitioner is, however, at liberty to take statutory recourse under appropriate provisions of the Act, 2013.
6. The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of with the aforesaid liberty.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Sanjay/
